scope: job filter labels and selection feedback, ambiguous home metrics, notification actions, and favorites-only workspace

baseline.finding: Database category values such as BACKEND were rendered directly, and Korean legacy values could produce a duplicate label after localization.
The checked-state CSS targeted .multi-filter-option[data-state='checked'], while the rendered filter used a native input without that wrapper or data-state.
Two cards labeled 신규 공고 and 마감 임박 were visible even though their calculation boundaries were not explained in the UI.
The entire notification card was a button that marked the row read and navigated when an internal href existed.
Folder creation, nesting, moving, trash recovery, and separate favorite controls exposed two overlapping organization models.

structuralComparison.metric: known English category codes with Korean display labels
ambiguous job summary cards on the home screen
implicit notification-card navigation surfaces per row

structuralComparison.after: up to 2: 읽음 처리 and 관련 내용 보기

structuralComparison.metric: workspace organization models exposed in the UI

implemented.jobCategories: Normalize raw and legacy category variants to one Korean display value for both filter state and catalog matching.
implemented.checkboxFeedback: Style the adjacent visual checkbox from input:checked and render a Check icon when selected.
implemented.home: Remove the two job counters and all folder-management controls, then expose coding favorites, saved jobs, and a deduplicated saved-item list.
implemented.legacyCollections: Keep existing collection rows and flatten their items by itemType and targetId so no saved item is discarded.
implemented.notifications: Use a static article for the message and separate read and navigation buttons with Korean notification type labels.
implemented.favoriteProblemQuery: Add an owner-scoped favorites filter to the D1 coding-problem query.

dataHandling.note: Folder-management UI is removed, but existing collection data remains readable through the unified favorites list.

limitations: No end-to-end latency improvement percentage is claimed because a matched production before-and-after timing sample was not captured.
The legacy collection API remains for backward-compatible storage while the user-facing workflow is favorites-only.
